stories.title: Double yellow lines proposed for Aston Road and Plough Lane junction in Queensferry
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is proposing double yellow lines at the junction of Aston Road and Plough Lane in Queensferry, on the Asda side and The Plough Inn side. stories.summary: Flintshire Council could spend money upgrading its last three public toilets and still face having to close them, a report has warned. stories.title: Wrexham to Bidston trains face cancellation after trackside fire on the Wirral
stories.summary: Trains between Wrexham Central and Bidston could be cancelled or delayed until 5pm today (Friday, October 2) because of a fire next to the track at Upton on the Wirral. stories.title: Garden City: Northern Gateway housing scheme falls short of 20% affordable homes target
stories.summary: Four hundred homes being built at Northern Gateway in Garden City were approved with no affordable housing, a council monitoring report shows. The council’s own policy asks for 20% in the area. The figures are in Flintshire’s third annual monitoring report on its Local Development Plan. stories.title: Flu vaccine kept 800 people out of hospital in Wales last winter
stories.summary: Flu vaccines kept more than 800 people in Wales out of hospital last winter, according to Public Health Wales, as people in Flintshire who are eligible are urged to book theirs.
